name: Computer Monitor
instruction: Design a 3D model of a computer monitor. It should have a slim bezel and a stand that allows for height adjustment. Include ports on the back for connectivity and buttons on the front or side for power and settings adjustments. The screen should be flat and rectangular.

Shape accuracy: The object in the images is a computer monitor.
The monitor has a slim bezel.
The screen is flat and rectangular.
The stand is designed for height adjustment.
Color representation: The color set in the script is reasonable for the object.
Size: The size set in the script is reasonable for the object.
Proportion: The screen is proportionate to the bezel.
The stand is proportionate to the monitor size.
Texture and surface detail: The texture and surface detail set in the script is reasonable for the object.

Three-dimensional spatial awareness: The monitor is properly supported by the height-adjustable stand.
The ports on the back are accessible without obstruction.
The buttons for power and settings are positioned for easy access.
Object distance and contact: The monitor does not overlap with the stand.
There is no gap between the monitor and the stand.
The ports are clearly visible and do not interfere with the monitor's design.

Instruction execution accuracy: All specified attributes are accurately represented.
The design includes a slim bezel, height-adjustable stand, and necessary ports and buttons.
